measurementProtocol: Pin source and executable identities, compiler/build configuration, archive hashes, mount order, map/entry identity, command schedule, seed and camera path before execution.
Use an isolated writable profile and an owned private display for graphical references. Record actual driver and renderer identity; a software GL driver is a distinct environment.
Record cold load separately from warmed steady-state operation; retain per-frame raw samples and timestamps rather than only average FPS.
Record CPU governor, available memory, GPU power/temperature and unrelated load observations. Do not change the user's system power settings to manufacture a result.

Propose a target only after the named workload has measurements; retain evidence, uncertainty and the acceptance decision beside the numeric proposal. Missing measurements or unadopted targets block performance closure.
